title: Charge coherent radiation and the source-independent outlet
statement: For static split fixed-polarization storage, each paired-photon history has K_kj,h=|k><j| tensor M_h with the SAME source operator for every polarization pair. The logical qubit moves into the first x/y photon; the second emission produces the atom-field pair. A fixed Bell measurement on those TWO photons and Pauli/frame recovery gives identity for every retained timing/source history. It requires source-independent recoil-free outlets L_l=sqrt(Gamma)D_l^dagger tensor I_E, coherent collection, polarization/time storage, FULL Bell POVM, Pauli operations and timed stopping. Source-dependent polarization/recoil or loss are outside the theorem. This is static coherent recovery, not a moving gate or completed physical memory.

requires: Two electrons/two spin-degenerate orbitals with common Hermitian hopping G_E, gI<=G_E<=hI, spin-independent interactions and qualified differential detuning; arbitrary source/reference/history correlations within the finite-orbital model.
Separately prepared orbital probes, complete charge instruments, real pair access/loading/return/routing, calibrated relative controls/reservoirs and explicit source-domain conditions.
